column1: # Rules, and why they are these rules:
#  * This list names only what is PERMITTED. It never names a forbidden path — in a public
#    repository a denylist would tell a reader exactly what to go looking for in history.
#    Anything not listed is caught, whatever it is called and whatever it contains.
#  * A reason is MANDATORY, so the next reader can tell a deliberate root from a stray one.
#  * Matching is on the EXACT directory name, not a prefix: a root sharing a name prefix
#    with a permitted one is not permitted. Asserted in the self-test.
#  * DIRECTORIES ONLY. Top-level files are deliberately not covered: they churn during
#    ordinary work, and a check that fires on ordinary work gets switched off.
#  * Adding a root here is a policy decision. Prefer putting new code under an existing
